text: Please can someone call me back. My stepdaughter is 7 and there are little dark dots coming up on her. She's got dark skin so I couldn't tell at first, but I looked at her palms and pulled her lower eyelid down and there are tiny red-purple spots there too. I pressed a glass on her hand and they're still there, they don't go away. Her temp is 37.7. The thing that's scaring me most is she's so hard to wake. I've been shaking her shoulder and saying her name and she barely opens her eyes and goes straight back off, she's just not with me like she normally is. Her dad's away and I don't know what to do
